title: Deformation of sine-Gordon two-soliton solutions in $\varphi^4$ kink-antikink configurations
summary: In this work, we construct analytical kink-antikink $(K\bar{K})$ configurations in the non-integrable $\varphi^4$ model by mapping exact solutions of the integrable sine-Gordon system via a field deformation. This procedure yields two distinct classes of configurations, parametrized by the initial half-separation and velocity. We compare these profiles with the standard additive superposition Ansatz in terms of vacuum structure and equation-of-motion residuals, deriving explicit closed-form expressions for the corresponding integrated squared residuals.
